heading_en: Alanine Scanning and the Hydrophobic Core
heading_zh: 丙氨酸扫描与疏水腔
en: Alanine's side chain is a single methyl group, the smallest side chain that still has real volume. Strictly the smallest of all belongs to glycine, a single hydrogen, but glycine effectively has no side chain, which makes its backbone the most flexible of the twenty and gives it a special role in turns and at the ends of helices. Alanine is the useful reference substitution precisely because it truncates everything beyond Cbeta while leaving backbone conformation and helix propensity intact, so only one variable changes. Glycine would add backbone flexibility as well, confounding a side-chain effect with a conformational one, and for the same reason positions that are already glycine or proline are normally skipped.

Alanine scanning answers a specific problem: two molecules, a peptide and a protein say, are known to bind, but no complex structure exists yet, so how they pack against each other is unknown. Mutate the residues believed to lie on the interaction interface to alanine, one at a time, and measure the binding affinity of each single mutant separately; that gives a contribution for each position. A large loss of affinity means the residue is critical for the interaction, while little change means it is not. The usual criterion for a hot spot is a binding free-energy change of about 1 to 2 kcal/mol or more. The classic human growth hormone receptor study showed that although the buried interface is large, the binding energy concentrates on a handful of hot-spot residues while most interface residues contribute almost nothing. One motivation for the whole exercise is affinity improvement: you must find the residues that actually make contact before you know what to engineer.

Valine, leucine and isoleucine are the three classic nonpolar residues, and the hydrophobic core is largely built from them. The qualifier that matters is side chain: their side chains form no hydrogen bonds at all, although their backbones still can, they are hydrophobic, and their size fits, so they pack the interior. Valine and isoleucine are additionally beta-branched, with branching already at Cbeta, and that steric bulk disfavours the alpha-helix and favours the beta-sheet. Isoleucine also carries a second chiral centre in its side chain, making it and threonine the two standard amino acids with two stereocentres.
zh: 丙氨酸 Ala 的侧链就是一个甲基 methyl，是最小的、但仍然具有真实体积的侧链。严格说最小的侧链属于甘氨酸 Gly，只有一个氢；但 Gly 实际上没有侧链，这使它的主链自由度是二十种氨基酸里最大的，也让它在转角 turn 和螺旋末端扮演特殊角色。Ala 之所以适合当作替换基准，恰恰是因为它只切掉 Cβ 以外的部分，主链构象和螺旋倾向基本不变，等于「只改一件事」。换成 Gly 还会额外引入主链柔性，把侧链效应和构象效应混在一起；同理，界面上原本就是 Gly 或 Pro 的位置通常不做扫描。

丙氨酸扫描 alanine scanning 解决的是一个很具体的问题：已知两个分子（比如一条多肽和一个蛋白质）能结合，但还没有解析出复合物结构 complex structure，因此不知道它们是怎么贴在一起的。把你认为处在相互作用界面 interface 上的氨基酸一个一个替换成丙氨酸，对每一个单突变体单独测定亲和力 affinity，就得到每个位点的贡献。换成 Ala 后亲和力大幅下降，说明该残基对互作是关键的；亲和力几乎不变，说明它不关键。hot spot 的常用判据是：突变为 Ala 后结合自由能变化 ΔΔG 达到约 1–2 kcal/mol 以上。经典的 hGH–受体界面研究显示，界面埋藏面积虽大，结合能却集中在少数几个 hot spot 残基上，大部分界面残基突变后几乎没有影响。做这件事的动机之一是进一步提高亲和力——先找出真正形成接触的残基，才知道该改造哪里。

缬氨酸 Val、亮氨酸 Leu、异亮氨酸 Ile 是三个典型的非极性 nonpolar 氨基酸，蛋白质的疏水腔 hydrophobic core 基本上就是由它们组成的。关键限定在侧链：这三者的侧链不能形成任何氢键 hydrogen bond（主链仍然可以），侧链疏水，体积也合适，因此正好填充内部。Val 和 Ile 还是 β-branched，在 Cβ 上就分支，由此产生的空间位阻使它们不利于 α-helix、偏好 β-sheet。Ile 的侧链还含第二个手性中心，所以它和 Thr 是含两个手性碳的两种标准氨基酸。

heading_en: Polarity, the Sulfur-Containing Residues, and the Hydroxyls of Serine and Threonine
heading_zh: 极性、含硫氨基酸，以及 Ser 与 Thr 的羟基
en: Amino acids whose side chains carry polar atoms, a thiol or a hydroxyl for instance, are classed as polar. The chemical definition behind the label is clearest in a serine side chain: oxygen pulls electrons harder than carbon, so the oxygen end carries more negative charge and the other end more positive. Charge is distributed unevenly, and that is what polarity means. It follows that side chains bearing hydroxyl or amino groups are polar, since O and N both outcompete C for electrons, and that such residues can generally form hydrogen bonds. Worth remembering, though, is that what an experiment reads out directly is hydrophilicity; polarity is a chemist's way of describing charge distribution, and biochemistry inherited many of its concepts from chemists explaining biology in chemical terms.

Cysteine and methionine are only partially polar, and the category has no sharp boundary. The chemistry behind that hedge is worth having. The cysteine thiol has a pKa of about 8.3, far below the roughly 13 of the serine hydroxyl, so a meaningful fraction exists as thiolate at physiological pH; that is the basis for cysteine acting as a nucleophile, coordinating Zn2+ in zinc fingers, and being oxidised to disulfide bonds, whereas serine needs a histidine to abstract its proton first. Methionine's sulfur, by contrast, is a thioether: it does not ionise, carries no charge and forms no disulfide. On the Kyte-Doolittle scale both methionine and cysteine score as hydrophobic, and methionine is common in the hydrophobic core, so memorising "contains sulfur, therefore polar" will mislead you.

Serine and threonine are the typical hydrophilic residues, both side chains a single hydroxyl substitution. The first role of that hydroxyl is catalysing hydrolysis: an entire protease class, the serine proteases, works through it. A hydroxyl alone is not enough, however; these enzymes use a Ser-His-Asp catalytic triad in which histidine removes the proton from the serine hydroxyl so it can attack the carbonyl carbon of the scissile peptide bond, while aspartate stabilises the protonated histidine, an arrangement shared by chymotrypsin, trypsin and thrombin. The more heavily examined role is as a phosphorylation site: phosphate is one phosphorus with four oxygens, one of which is exchanged for the side-chain oxygen, making serine and threonine the commonest phospho-acceptors. The third eukaryotic acceptor is tyrosine: roughly 85 to 90 per cent of mammalian phosphosites are phosphoserine, about 10 per cent phosphothreonine and only 1 to 2 per cent phosphotyrosine, yet phosphotyrosine dominates receptor tyrosine kinase signalling and is the target of most kinase-inhibitor cancer drugs.
zh: 侧链上含有极性原子（例如巯基 -SH、羟基 -OH）的氨基酸被称为极性 polar 氨基酸。这个名称背后的化学定义，用丝氨酸的侧链最容易看清楚：氧夺电子的能力比碳强，所以氧那一端带更多负电荷、另一端带更多正电荷。电荷分布不均匀，这就是极性的含义。由此可推论：带羟基或带氨基的侧链都有极性，因为 O 和 N 的夺电子能力都比 C 强，而且这类氨基酸一般都能形成氢键 hydrogen bond。但要记住，实验里能直接体现出来的其实是亲水性 hydrophilicity；极性只是化学角度描述电荷分布的说法，而生物化学的许多概念本来就来自一群化学家用化学的传统思维去解释生物现象。

半胱氨酸 Cys 和甲硫氨酸 Met 只是「部分极性」，这个范畴本来就没有清晰界限，但它背后的化学值得掌握。Cys 巯基的 pKa 约 8.3，远低于 Ser 羟基的约 13，因此在生理 pH 下已有可观比例以硫醇负离子 thiolate 存在；这正是 Cys 能做亲核催化、能配位 Zn2+（锌指 zinc finger）、能被氧化成二硫键 disulfide bond 的化学基础，而 Ser 需要 His 先帮忙夺走质子。相比之下，Met 的硫是硫醚 thioether：不解离、不带电，也不参与二硫键。在 Kyte–Doolittle 疏水性标度里，Met 和 Cys 其实都被归为疏水残基，Met 还常出现在疏水核心，所以把「含硫＝极性」直接背下来会出错。

丝氨酸 Ser 和苏氨酸 Thr 是典型的亲水氨基酸，侧链都是单羟基取代。羟基的第一个作用是催化水解 hydrolysis：有一整类蛋白酶就叫丝氨酸蛋白酶 serine protease，靠这个羟基工作。但只有一个羟基是不够的：这类酶使用 Ser–His–Asp 催化三联体 catalytic triad，His 夺走 Ser 羟基上的质子，使其成为强亲核体去进攻被切肽键的羰基碳，Asp 则稳定质子化的 His；胰凝乳蛋白酶 chymotrypsin、胰蛋白酶 trypsin、凝血酶 thrombin 共享这同一套机制。羟基更常被考的作用是作为磷酸化 phosphorylation 位点：磷酸基团是一个磷连四个氧，其中一个氧可以被侧链的氧取代，因此 Ser 和 Thr 是最常见的磷酸化受体。真核磷酸化的第三个受体是酪氨酸 Tyr：哺乳动物磷酸化位点中大致 85–90% 是 pSer、约 10% 是 pThr、只有 1–2% 是 pTyr；但 pTyr 几乎主导受体酪氨酸激酶 RTK 的信号通路，也是绝大多数激酶抑制剂类抗肿瘤药的靶点。

heading_en: Charged Side Chains, Salt Bridges, Histidine and Proline
heading_zh: 带电侧链与盐桥，His 与 Pro
en: Aspartate and glutamate come paired with their amide forms, asparagine and glutamine. Glutamate has one more methylene in its side chain than aspartate, so within that pair the difference is only chain length. Aspartate and glutamate can exist in a charged, deprotonated form carrying negative charge and can therefore form salt bridges; asparagine and glutamine cannot, because the carboxyl has been replaced by an amide and no charged form is available.

Lysine and arginine are the strongly basic pair: both have long side chains, both carry positive charge, and both can pair with a negative aspartate or glutamate in a salt bridge. The lysine side chain is four methylenes plus a terminal epsilon-amino group, arginine three methylenes plus a guanidinium. Arginine's positive charge is delocalised over the three nitrogens of the guanidinium, so it stays charged at essentially any physiological pH and can make bidentate hydrogen bonds, which is why arginine dominates nucleic-acid-binding surfaces and phosphate pockets. As a rule of thumb, side chains containing oxygen tend to become negative and side chains containing amino groups tend to become positive.

Histidine is the special one among the heterocyclic residues. It has three charge states and is conventionally grouped with the basic, positively charged residues, but the number to hold onto is the imidazole side-chain pKa of about 6.0: at pH 7.0 only around 10 per cent of the side chain is protonated and free histidine has a net charge near zero. The examinable point is that histidine is the only side chain with a pKa near physiological pH, which is exactly why it can buffer and why it serves as the proton shuttle in general acid-base catalysis, as in the Ser-His-Asp triad. The side-chain pKa values worth memorising are aspartate 3.9, glutamate 4.25, histidine 6.0, cysteine 8.3, tyrosine 10.1, lysine 10.5 and arginine 12.5. It follows directly that at pH 7 aspartate and glutamate are fully deprotonated and negative, lysine and arginine fully protonated and positive, and only histidine is switchable, the starting point of many mechanism questions.

Proline is the rigid residue: its side chain closes back onto the backbone as a fixed ring that cannot swing freely, a property that returns when tertiary structure is discussed. One point on hydrolysis belongs here as well. There are three routes, acid, alkaline and enzymatic. Acid hydrolysis is the more complete one but destroys some amino acids along the way: 6 M HCl at 110 degrees for 24 hours destroys tryptophan completely and deamidates asparagine and glutamine to aspartate and glutamate, which is why composition analyses report Asx and Glx. Alkaline hydrolysis preserves tryptophan but destroys serine, threonine, cysteine and arginine and causes racemisation. Enzymatic hydrolysis is mild and specific but often incomplete.
zh: 天冬氨酸 Asp 和谷氨酸 Glu 与它们对应的酰胺化形式天冬酰胺 Asn、谷氨酰胺 Gln 成对出现。Glu 的侧链比 Asp 多一个亚甲基 methylene，所以这一对之间的差别只在侧链长度。Asp 和 Glu 可以以带电的（去质子）形式存在，带负电，因此能形成盐桥 salt bridge；Asn 和 Gln 则不能，因为羧基已被酰胺取代，没有可用的带电形式。

赖氨酸 Lys 和精氨酸 Arg 是碱性较强的一对：侧链都比较长，都带正电，都可以和带负电的 Asp 或 Glu 形成盐桥。Lys 的侧链是 4 个亚甲基 CH2 加一个末端 ε-氨基，Arg 是 3 个亚甲基加一个胍基 guanidinium。Arg 的正电荷离域在胍基的三个氮上，因此几乎在任何生理 pH 下都带电，并且能同时做双齿氢键——这就是 Arg 常出现在核酸结合面和磷酸结合口袋的原因。作为记忆规则：侧链上含氧原子的一般可以带负电，含氨基的一般带正电。

组氨酸 His 是杂环氨基酸中比较特殊的一个。它有三种带电形式，习惯上也被归入碱性、带正电的一类，但真正要记住的数字是咪唑 imidazole 侧链的 pKa 约为 6.0：在 pH 7.0 时只有约 10% 的侧链被质子化，游离 His 的净电荷接近 0。真正的考点是：His 是唯一 pKa 落在生理 pH 附近的侧链，所以它既能起缓冲 buffering 作用，又能在酶活性中心充当广义酸碱催化的质子中转站，例如 Ser–His–Asp 三联体。值得背下来的侧链 pKa 是：Asp 3.9、Glu 4.25、His 6.0、Cys 8.3、Tyr 10.1、Lys 10.5、Arg 12.5。由此可直接推出：在 pH 7 时 Asp/Glu 已完全去质子而带负电，Lys/Arg 完全质子化而带正电，唯有 His 处在可切换状态——这是很多机制题的起点。

脯氨酸 Pro 是带有刚性 rigidity 的氨基酸：它的侧链回接到主链上成为固定的环，不能随意摆动；这个性质在讲三级结构时还会用到。关于水解也有一点应放在这里。水解有三种方式：酸水解、碱水解、酶水解。酸水解比较彻底，但过程中会破坏一部分氨基酸本身：6 M HCl、110 °C、24 h 会完全破坏色氨酸 Trp，并把 Asn/Gln 脱酰胺成 Asp/Glu，所以氨基酸组成分析报告的是 Asx 和 Glx。碱水解能保住 Trp，却会破坏 Ser、Thr、Cys 和 Arg，还会引起消旋 racemization。酶水解条件温和、特异性强，但往往切不完全。

heading_en: Aromatic Residues and the Ultraviolet Quantification of Protein
heading_zh: 芳香族氨基酸与蛋白质的紫外定量
en: For the three aromatic amino acids, phenylalanine, tyrosine and tryptophan, one property carries most of the weight: they absorb ultraviolet light in the 250 to 280 nm range, an absorbance that arises physically from pi to pi-star transitions of the aromatic ring. What is measured at 280 nm, however, comes almost entirely from tryptophan and tyrosine; phenylalanine peaks near 257 nm and barely absorbs at 280 at all. Absorbance near 280 nm can therefore report how much protein is present, which is the operating principle of the nanodrop, but only as an approximation: aromatic content is not really constant from protein to protein, and a protein containing no tryptophan is badly underestimated or effectively invisible by A280 and must be quantified colorimetrically, by BCA or Bradford.

The conversion rests on the Beer-Lambert law, A equals epsilon times c times l, absorbance equals molar extinction coefficient times concentration times path length, the path length conventionally 1 cm. A protein's extinction coefficient at 280 nm can be computed straight from its sequence, roughly 5500 per tryptophan plus 1490 per tyrosine plus 125 per cystine, in units of per molar per cm, so the proper practice is to compute epsilon with a tool such as ProtParam rather than assume a generic factor.

OD stands for optical density, the absorbance reading at one particular wavelength; the lab commonly quotes OD600 or OD450, OD600 the most used. The two measurements should be kept apart: bacterial OD600 and protein A280 are not the same kind of thing. OD600 mostly reports light scattering by whole cells rather than molecular absorption, so it does not strictly obey Beer-Lambert and departs visibly from linearity above about 0.6 to 0.8. The correct practice is to dilute, read, and multiply back by the dilution factor.

The same chemistry underlies tryptophan fluorescence, with excitation near 280 nm and emission near 340 nm. The emission wavelength is highly sensitive to the local environment, blue-shifting when the tryptophan is buried in the hydrophobic core and red-shifting on exposure to water, which makes it a routine probe of unfolding and of ligand binding.
zh: 三个芳香族氨基酸——苯丙氨酸 Phe、酪氨酸 Tyr、色氨酸 Trp——最重要的一个特点是：它们在 250–280 nm 波长有紫外光吸收 UV absorption，这种吸收的物理来源是芳香环的 π→π* 跃迁。但在 280 nm 测到的吸收几乎全部来自 Trp 和 Tyr；Phe 的 λmax 约在 257 nm，在 280 nm 几乎不吸收。因此 280 nm 附近的吸光度可以用来判断蛋白质含量，这正是 nanodrop 测蛋白浓度的原理，但它只是一个近似：各蛋白的芳香族含量其实并不真的一致，不含 Trp 的蛋白用 A280 定量会严重偏低甚至几乎测不到，必须改用 BCA 或 Bradford 这类显色法。

换算的依据是比尔-朗伯定律 Beer–Lambert law，A = ε·c·l，即吸光度 = 摩尔消光系数 × 浓度 × 光程，光程习惯取 1 cm。蛋白在 280 nm 的 ε 几乎可以直接由序列算出：ε280 ≈ 5500 ×（Trp 数）+ 1490 ×（Tyr 数）+ 125 ×（胱氨酸对数），单位 M⁻¹cm⁻¹；所以规范做法是用 ProtParam 之类的工具按序列计算 ε，而不是套一个通用系数。

OD 是 optical density（光密度），指在某个特定波长下的吸光读数；实验室常说 OD600、OD450，其中最常用的是 OD600。这两种测量要分清楚：细菌的 OD600 和蛋白的 A280 不是一回事。OD600 测到的主要是整个细胞对光的散射 scattering，而不是分子吸收，因此严格说并不服从比尔-朗伯定律，读数超过约 0.6–0.8 就明显偏离线性。正确做法是稀释后测量，再乘回稀释倍数。
同一套化学也是色氨酸荧光的基础：激发约 280 nm、发射约 340 nm。它的发射波长对所处的微环境极其敏感，Trp 埋在疏水核心时蓝移，暴露到水中时红移，因此这是监测蛋白去折叠和配体结合的常规手段。

heading_en: Rare Amino Acids, pKa, the A260/A280 Ratio and Edman Degradation
heading_zh: 稀有氨基酸、pKa、A260/A280 与 Edman 降解
en: Two rare amino acids are worth naming, both modifications of standard residues. The first is selenocysteine, the twenty-first amino acid, in which a selenium atom replaces the sulfur of cysteine; it is genuinely present in humans, in the glutathione peroxidases, thioredoxin reductase and the deiodinases, recoded from a UGA codon with the help of a SECIS element in the mRNA. The second is pyrrolysine, the twenty-second, in which a pyrroline-type heterocycle is attached to the basic epsilon-amino group of a lysine side chain; it is encoded by UAG, occurs only in some methanogenic archaea and a few bacteria, and is absent from humans. Knowing that these exist is enough. Isoelectric point and its formulas matter less in practice; what does need holding firmly is that different residues have different pKa values, that a pKa expresses a group's tendency to take up or release a proton, and that a lower pKa means the proton is released more readily.

Sample quality is judged on the nanodrop from the OD260/OD280 ratio. A clean protein sample sits between about 0.6 and 0.7; for reference, pure protein gives about 0.57, pure DNA 1.8 and pure RNA 2.0. A ratio well above 0.8, or reaching 1, means nucleic acid contamination, since nucleic acid absorbs strongly at 260 nm. The ratio answers only whether nucleic acid is present, not whether the protein is pure or intact, which needs SDS-PAGE and size-exclusion chromatography.

Two routes remove the contamination. One is a broad-spectrum nuclease of the benzonase type, which digests all nucleic acid indiscriminately. The other is a heparin column, a polysaccharide affinity resin: heparin is heavily sulfated and mimics the polyanionic backbone of DNA, so what it binds is nucleic-acid-binding protein, that is, your target. The nucleic acid and the non-binders leave in the flow-through, the protein is retained, and a salt gradient elutes it.

Of the chemistry of amino acids, the reaction to remember is Edman degradation, a chemical sequencing method still used commercially that reads residues one at a time from the N-terminus. It runs in three steps: phenylisothiocyanate couples to the free alpha-amino group under alkaline conditions, acid cleaves off the terminal residue, and the resulting PTH-amino acid is identified, then the cycle repeats. Two limits are examined often. A blocked N-terminus, from acetylation or a pyroglutamate, stops it dead; and because the per-cycle efficiency is below 100 per cent, the losses accumulate and a run reads only some 30 to 50 residues, which is exactly why a long protein must first be cleaved into peptides.
zh: 有两种稀有氨基酸值得点名，它们都是经典氨基酸的修饰产物。第一种是硒代半胱氨酸 selenocysteine，即第 21 种氨基酸，其中硒 Se 原子取代了半胱氨酸里的硫 S；它确实存在于人体，出现在谷胱甘肽过氧化物酶 GPX、硫氧还蛋白还原酶 TrxR 和脱碘酶中，由 UGA 密码子在 mRNA 的 SECIS 元件参与下重编码翻译。第二种是吡咯赖氨酸 pyrrolysine，即第 22 种，在赖氨酸侧链末端的碱性 ε-氨基上额外连接一个吡咯型杂环；它由 UAG 编码，只见于部分产甲烷古菌和少数细菌，人体内并不存在。知道有这两个东西就够了。氨基酸的等电点 pI 和相关公式在实际工作中分量不大；真正要记牢的是：不同氨基酸有不同的 pKa，pKa 代表该基团接受或释放氢离子 H⁺ 的能力，pKa 越低表示越容易释放出氢离子。

样品质量在 nanodrop 上靠 OD260/OD280 判断。干净的蛋白样品这个数值在约 0.6–0.7 之间；作为参照，纯蛋白约 0.57，纯 DNA 为 1.8，纯 RNA 为 2.0。比值远高于 0.8 甚至到 1，就说明有核酸 nucleic acid 污染，因为核酸在 260 nm 吸收很强。这个比值只能回答「有没有核酸」，回答不了蛋白纯不纯、有没有降解——那要靠 SDS-PAGE 和分子筛层析 SEC。
去除污染有两个手段。一是超级核酸酶（benzonase 一类），无差别地把所有核酸消化掉。二是肝素柱 heparin column，一种多糖亲和柱：肝素是高度硫酸化的多糖，模拟 DNA 的负电骨架，所以它结合的是核酸结合蛋白，也就是你的目标蛋白。核酸和不结合的杂质随流穿 flow-through 出去，目标蛋白被保留，再用高盐梯度洗脱。

在氨基酸的化学反应里，要记住的是 Edman 降解：这是商业上现在仍在使用的化学测序方法，从 N 端（氮端）开始一个一个地读残基。它分三步：苯异硫氰酸酯 PITC 在碱性下与游离 α-氨基反应，酸性条件切下末端残基，再鉴定生成的 PTH-氨基酸，然后重复循环。两个限制常考。其一，N 端若被封闭（乙酰化、焦谷氨酸等），反应就完全做不动；其二，每轮效率不到 100%，累积下来实际只能连续读约 30–50 个残基，这正是长蛋白必须先酶切成肽段再测的原因。

heading_en: Primary Structure: Quantification, the Peptide Bond, and Sequencing
heading_zh: 一级结构：定量、肽键与测序
en: A protein's covalent structure is its primary structure: the composition of its amino acids and the order in which they are arranged. The oldest way of measuring how much protein is present is the Kjeldahl method: nitrogen makes up about 16 per cent of a protein by weight, so the protein is burned away, the inorganic nitrogen is weighed, and multiplying by 6.25, that is 100 over 16, gives the protein mass. It is seldom used now, and the reason is instructive. Kjeldahl measures total nitrogen, not protein, so any nitrogen-rich adulterant is counted as protein; that is precisely the loophole the melamine milk scandal exploited, and why modern quantification uses BCA, Bradford or A280.

On size, insulin is conventionally taken as the smallest protein, 5808 Da for the human form and 5733 Da for the bovine, 51 residues in all as a 21-residue A chain and a 30-residue B chain joined by disulfide bonds; anything below about 6000 Da counts as a small polypeptide, though the line is not sharp. Calling insulin the smallest protein is only a convention; what makes it canonical is that it was the first protein whose sequence was determined in full, by Sanger in the 1950s, proving that proteins have defined sequences. By convention a peptide is written from the N-terminus to the C-terminus.

The peptide bond has two resonance forms: the C=O double bond can shift into a C=N double bond, so the bond lies between a single and a double bond, roughly a bond and a half. Quantitatively the peptide C-N bond is about 1.32 angstrom, between the 1.49 of a C-N single bond and the 1.27 of a C=N double bond, about 40 per cent double-bond character. It is accordingly more stable than an ordinary C-N single bond but less than a true double bond, and it is planar. The rotational barrier is around 20 kcal/mol, so the omega dihedral is locked near 180 degrees, trans, the one notable exception being the X-Pro bond, whose cis form can reach several to over ten per cent. The real consequence of planarity is that each residue keeps only two rotatable backbone dihedrals, phi and psi, which is why a two-dimensional Ramachandran plot exhausts backbone conformational space.

Two further items belong here. The biuret reaction detects protein by complexing Cu2+ under alkaline conditions to a violet product read at 540 nm; it needs at least two peptide bonds, so tripeptides and larger give colour while a dipeptide does not. Glutathione is a special small peptide whose glutamate forms its peptide bond through the gamma-carboxyl rather than the usual alpha-carboxyl, the point to memorise; it matters in denaturation and refolding because it can undo wrongly formed disulfide bonds and promote the correct ones. For sequencing, Edman reads continuously from the N-terminus, while the now more common shotgun method combines enzymatic cleavage, HPLC and MS: enzymes hydrolyse the protein into peptides, HPLC separates them, each fragment's mass and composition is determined, and the overlaps reassemble the full-length sequence. Older routes such as hydrazinolysis are no longer used.
zh: 蛋白质的共价结构就是它的一级结构 primary structure，即氨基酸的组成与排列顺序。测定蛋白含量最古老的方法是凯氏定氮法 Kjeldahl：氮元素在蛋白质中约占重量的 16%，因此把蛋白「烧掉」，称量无机氮的重量，再乘以 6.25（即 100/16），就能推算蛋白质量。现在已不常用，原因很有教育意义：凯氏定氮测的是总氮而不是蛋白，任何含氮杂质都会被折算成蛋白；三聚氰胺奶粉事件正是钻了这个空子，这也是为什么现代蛋白定量改用 BCA、Bradford 或 A280。

关于大小，习惯上把胰岛素 insulin 当作最小的蛋白质：人胰岛素 5808 Da，牛胰岛素 5733 Da，共 51 个残基，由 21 个残基的 A 链和 30 个残基的 B 链通过二硫键连接；小于约 6000 Da 的一般算小多肽 polypeptide，但这个界限并不严格。而且「最小的蛋白质」本来也只是一种习惯说法。胰岛素真正之所以经典，是因为它是第一个被完整测定氨基酸序列的蛋白（Sanger，1950 年代），从而证明了蛋白质具有确定的序列。书写惯例上，肽链一般从 N 端（氮端）写到 C 端（碳端）。

肽键存在两种共振式 resonance：碳氧双键 C=O 可以共振成碳氮双键 C=N 的形式，因此肽键介于单键与双键之间，可以理解为「1.5 个键」。定量地说，肽键的 C–N 键长约 1.32 Å，介于 C–N 单键的 1.49 Å 与 C=N 双键的 1.27 Å 之间，双键成分约 40%。相应地，肽键比普通的 C–N 单键更稳定，但没有真正的双键那么稳定，而且它是典型的平面 planar 的键。绕这个键旋转的能垒约 20 kcal/mol，所以 ω 二面角基本被锁在 180°（trans），唯一显著的例外是 X–Pro 肽键，其 cis 形式可占百分之几到十几。平面性真正的后果是：主链上每个残基只剩 φ 和 ψ 两个可转二面角，这正是 Ramachandran plot 能用一张二维图穷尽主链构象的前提。

还有两件事属于这里。双缩脲反应 biuret reaction 在碱性条件下用铜离子 Cu2+ 络合成配合物、呈紫色，在 540 nm 比色定量；它需要至少 2 个肽键，所以三肽以上才显色、二肽不显色。谷胱甘肽 glutathione 是一个特殊的小肽：其中的谷氨酸用 γ-羧基而不是经典的 α-羧基参与成肽键，这是必记的点；它在蛋白变性—复性 refolding 过程中很重要，能解开错误形成的二硫键、促成正确折叠的二硫键。至于测序，Edman 是从 N 端开始的连续测序；现在更常用的是酶裂解 + HPLC + MS 的鸟枪法 shotgun：用不同的酶把蛋白水解成肽段，用高效液相色谱 HPLC 分离，逐段测定分子量与组成，最后按重叠区拼接还原全长序列。肼解法一类的老方法现在已经没人再用。

heading_en: The Levels of Protein Structure
heading_zh: 蛋白质结构的层次
en: Secondary, tertiary and quaternary structure all fall under a single heading, the protein's spatial structure. The classic definition is that a protein is formed by the folding of a polypeptide, possesses a defined spatial structure, and that this particular structure corresponds to a particular biological function, the familiar idea that structure determines function. Biochemistry traditionally writes the levels as 1, 2, 3 and 4 with a degree sign, though the current literature generally no longer does. Primary structure, the order of the amino acids, is not counted as higher-order structure; only the second, third and fourth levels are.

Secondary structure is the way the polypeptide backbone folds. It is defined on the backbone because every hydrogen bond stabilising it runs between backbone N-H and C=O groups, independent of the side chains, which is why phi and psi alone distinguish an alpha-helix from a beta-sheet. Tertiary structure is the folding of one entire polypeptide chain, and that is the clearest distinction: one tertiary structure can contain many independent secondary structures, strung together into one complete chain. It is stabilised instead by side-chain interactions, the hydrophobic effect above all, with salt bridges, hydrogen bonds and disulfide bonds; backbone versus side chain is the most reliable test of which level you are looking at. Anfinsen's ribonuclease A experiment showed that the information for the fold lies in the sequence: denature with urea and beta-mercaptoethanol to break all four disulfides, remove the denaturant, and the protein refolds spontaneously with its activity restored.

Quaternary structure describes the relative spatial arrangement of the subunits of an oligomeric protein. Not every protein has one, because not every protein is oligomeric; the term applies only when several monomers, several tertiary structures, associate into an oligomer. Those that do generally correspond to some special biological function, since organisms do not spend energy pointlessly, and haemoglobin is the worked example to come. Supersecondary structure is an older term, now rarely used, for two or three secondary structures arranged in a particular way without reaching the tertiary level of a whole folded chain; these arrangements are the motifs, beta-alpha-beta, helix-turn-helix, the beta-hairpin, the Greek key. A motif is not a domain: a domain is an independently folding, often independently functional module of typically 100 to 200 residues that can be excised and expressed on its own, whereas a motif need not fold independently, and one domain usually contains several motifs.

The SARS-CoV-2 polymerase, RdRp, is a classic protein with quaternary structure, a complex of nsp12 with nsp7 and two copies of nsp8, which is also why it is comparatively hard to express and prepare. Biochemistry describes a polymerase as shaped like a right hand with three standard parts: the fingers bind the incoming nucleoside triphosphate and the template strand, the palm holds the catalytic centre with its two metal ions, the two-metal-ion mechanism, and the thumb clamps the double-stranded product already synthesised. Remdesivir is a nucleoside analogue acting at that catalytic centre.
zh: 二级、三级、四级结构都可以归到同一个话题下，即蛋白质的空间结构。经典定义是：蛋白质由多肽折叠形成，具有一定的空间结构，而且这个特殊的空间结构要对应特殊的生物学功能——也就是老生常谈的「结构影响功能」。生化里传统上用 1°、2°、3°、4°（数字右上角一个度）表示各级结构，不过现在的文献一般不这样写了。一级结构是氨基酸的排列顺序，不属于高级结构；高级结构只包括二、三、四级。

二级结构 secondary structure 是多肽链主链 backbone 的折叠方式。之所以定义在主链上，是因为稳定它的氢键全部发生在主链的 N–H 与 C=O 之间，与侧链是什么无关——这也是为什么只看 φ 和 ψ 就能判断是 α-helix 还是 β-sheet。三级结构 tertiary structure 是一整条完整多肽链的折叠，这是最明显的区分：一个三级结构上可以存在许多个相互独立的二级结构，很多个二级结构串起来才形成一条完整的肽链。三级结构则主要靠侧链之间的作用力稳定：疏水作用 hydrophobic effect 是最主要的驱动力，此外还有盐桥、氢键和二硫键；这条「主链 vs 侧链」的区分，是判别你在看哪一级结构最可靠的标准。折叠的信息藏在序列里，这正是 Anfinsen 用核糖核酸酶 A 做的复性实验所说明的：用尿素加 β-巯基乙醇变性、打开四对二硫键，再除去变性剂，蛋白便自发复性，活性得以恢复。

四级结构 quaternary structure 描述寡聚 oligomeric 蛋白各亚基之间的空间相对位置排布。并不是所有蛋白都有，因为不是所有蛋白都是寡聚形式的；只有当好几个单体（即好几个三级结构）通过相互作用连成寡聚体时，才谈得上四级结构。有四级结构的蛋白一般都对应某些特殊的生物学功能，因为生物不会白白花费能量去做没有意义的事情；血红蛋白 hemoglobin 就是后面要详细讲的例子。超二级结构 supersecondary structure 是一个较古早、现在已不常提的概念，指两三个二级结构以某种特殊方式排列起来，但还没有达到「一整条多肽链折叠」的三级结构层次；这类排列就是 motif，例如 βαβ、helix-turn-helix、β-hairpin、Greek key。motif 不等于结构域 domain。domain 指能独立折叠、常常能独立行使功能的模块，通常 100–200 个残基，可以被剪切出来单独表达；而 motif 只是几个二级结构单元的固定排列，本身并不要求能独立折叠；一个结构域里通常含有多个 motif。

SARS-CoV-2 的聚合酶 RdRp 是典型的有四级结构的蛋白，由 nsp12 与 nsp7 以及两拷贝 nsp8 组成复合物，这也是它比较难表达制备的原因。生化上把聚合酶的形状比作一只右手，包含三个标准部分：fingers 结合进入的核苷三磷酸 NTP 和模板链，palm 是催化中心、含两个金属离子（two-metal-ion mechanism），thumb 夹住已经合成好的双链产物。瑞德西韦 remdesivir 就是作用于这个催化中心的核苷类似物。

heading_en: Domain Division of Labour in a Polymerase, and What Counts as Quaternary Structure
heading_zh: 聚合酶的结构域分工,以及什么才算四级结构
en: The catalytic core of a polymerase — the core protein, or replication core, of the literature — is built from three domains: palm, fingers and thumb. The catalytic centre lies in the palm, where two conserved aspartates coordinate two Mg2+ ions in the two-metal-ion mechanism. The fingers bind the incoming nucleoside triphosphate and read the templating base, opening and closing on every cycle. The thumb grips the newly synthesised duplex and sets processivity. The core does nothing but templated extension; opening the duplex ahead of it is the job of a separate helicase, nsp13 in SARS-CoV-2.

In a virus the polymerase is therefore not one enzyme but a complex, because viral mRNA must carry a 5' cap and a poly(A) tail before the host's eukaryotic translation machinery will recognise it. In SARS-CoV-2 the capping work is distributed: the NiRAN domain of nsp12 performs the GTP transfer step, nsp14 is the N7-methyltransferase, nsp16 with its nsp10 cofactor the 2'-O-methyltransferase, and nsp13 also has RNA triphosphatase activity. The poly(A) tail is not appended enzymatically after transcription at all — it is copied from a poly(U) stretch on the negative strand.

Each activity sits in its own domain, an independently folding unit of tertiary structure, and because the activities follow one another closely in time and space, the chains carrying them assemble into an oligomer. The vocabulary has to be exact: quaternary structure means two or more separate polypeptide chains, that is subunits, held together non-covalently. Domains folded within a single chain, however many, remain tertiary structure. Multi-domain is not multi-subunit, and the distinction is a favourite exam trap.

An oligomer is small, generally no more than about ten subunits, and English distinguishes a homo-oligomer of identical chains from a hetero-oligomer of different ones. The core of the SARS-CoV-2 replication complex is a textbook hetero-oligomer: one nsp12, one nsp7 and two copies of nsp8, a heterotetramer.
zh: 聚合酶的催化核心 core——文献里说的 core protein 或复制 core——由三个 domain 组成:palm 手掌区、fingers 手指区、thumb 拇指区。催化中心在 palm 区,两个保守的 aspartate 在这里配位两个 Mg2+,走的是 two-metal-ion mechanism。fingers 区结合进入的核苷三磷酸并读取模板碱基,每一轮催化都要开合一次。thumb 区抓住已合成的双链产物,决定 processivity 持续合成能力。这个 core 只做依模板延伸这一件事;把前方的双链打开靠的是另一个酶,即解旋酶 helicase,在 SARS-CoV-2 里是 nsp13。

所以在病毒里,聚合酶不是一个酶而是一个 complex,因为病毒 mRNA 必须带上 5' cap 和 poly(A) 尾巴,宿主的真核翻译机器才会识别它。SARS-CoV-2 的加帽是分工完成的:nsp12 的 NiRAN 结构域负责 GTP 转移这一步,nsp14 做 N7-甲基化,nsp16(以 nsp10 为辅因子)做 2'-O-甲基化,nsp13 还兼有 RNA 三磷酸酶活性。而 poly(A) 尾巴根本不是转录后由酶加上去的——它是从负链上的一段 poly(U) 模板复制出来的。

这些功能各自占据一个 domain,也就是可以独立折叠的三级结构单位;又因为它们在时间和空间上前后相接,承载它们的多肽链会组装成寡聚体 oligomer。这里的术语必须用准:四级结构 quaternary structure 指两条或以上独立的多肽链,也就是亚基 subunit,通过非共价作用结合在一起。同一条链上折叠出来的多个 domain,无论多少个,都仍然只是三级结构。多结构域不等于多亚基,这个区别是常考的陷阱。
寡聚体规模很小,一般不超过十个亚基;英文还区分同源寡聚 homo-oligomer(同一种链的多个拷贝)和异源寡聚 hetero-oligomer(不同的链)。SARS-CoV-2 复制复合物的核心正是 hetero-oligomer 的教科书例子:一份 nsp12、一份 nsp7 加两份 nsp8,构成一个异源四聚体 heterotetramer。

heading_en: Why Multi-Subunit Complexes Resist Production, and How Cryo-EM Copes With Them
heading_zh: 多亚基复合物为什么难做出来,以及 cryo-EM 如何应对
en: A polymerase is hard to produce because it is not a single entity but many subunits combined, each of them often unstable on its own. They fit together like building blocks, or like a mortise-and-tenon joint, and only once fitted does the whole become a stable structure. That splits the problem in two: every different subunit has to be obtained, and they then have to be assembled correctly under suitable conditions before the complex can do anything physiological.

The standard solution to the second half is not separate purification followed by mixing but co-expression: the MultiBac system in baculovirus-infected Sf9 insect cells, or polycistronic and dual-plasmid systems in E. coli, so that subunits fold in the same cell and assemble co-translationally, helped by co-expressed chaperones, solubility fusion tags and a lowered induction temperature. Even so, artificial assembly in vitro cannot match the precision of a living cell, which assembles essentially everything correctly, and some fraction always comes out wrong. The monkeypox virus polymerase is the instructive case: the hard part is that it does not assemble completely. If the enzyme has components A, B and C, some particles are only A+B, because C never attached properly, and others are B+C.

This is the situation cryo-EM was made for. It needs no crystals, and multi-subunit, flexible, partly assembled complexes are precisely the ones that refuse to crystallise. The single-particle workflow runs: vitrify the sample, collect micrographs, apply motion correction and CTF estimation, pick particles, run 2D classification to see the protein from its different orientations and discard ice, debris and bad particles, build an initial model, run 3D classification, refine, and judge resolution by the gold-standard FSC = 0.143 criterion.

The decisive step for a badly assembled sample is 3D classification, which separates fully from partly assembled particles computationally — something crystallography cannot do, since a heterogeneous sample either fails to crystallise or yields one averaged model. One caution over terminology: a subunit is a separate polypeptide chain, a domain an independently folding unit within one chain. In a coloured structure figure each colour is usually a domain, and it is the number of subunits that decides whether there is quaternary structure at all.
zh: 聚合酶难生产,是因为它不是一个单独的个体,而是很多亚基组合到一起,每个亚基单独存在时往往并不稳定。它们之间像积木、像榫卯一样拼插起来,拼插好以后整体才形成稳定的结构。这就把问题拆成两半:先要把不同的亚基都拿到手,然后还要在合适的条件下让它们正确组装起来,复合物才能发挥生理功能。

后半个问题的常规解法不是分别纯化再混合,而是共表达 co-expression:昆虫细胞 baculovirus/Sf9 的 MultiBac 系统,或大肠杆菌里的多顺反子、双质粒共转,让各亚基在同一个细胞里同时折叠、边合成边组装(co-translational assembly),并辅以共表达分子伴侣 chaperone、可溶性融合标签和降低诱导温度。即便如此,人为的体外组装也做不到活细胞那样精妙——体内基本能百分之百正确组装,人为组装最后总有一部分是错的。猴痘病毒 monkeypox 的聚合酶就是最典型的例子:它难就难在组装得不完全。假如这个酶由 A、B、C 三个组分构成,有些颗粒只是 A+B(C 没有正确贴上去),另一些颗粒则是 B+C。

这正是冷冻电镜 cryo-EM 派上用场的场合。它不需要结晶,而多亚基、柔性、部分组装的复合物恰恰最长不出晶体。单颗粒流程是:冻样 → 采集照片 micrographs → 运动矫正 motion correction 与 CTF 估计 → 挑颗粒 particle picking → 做 2D classification,看到蛋白在不同角度下的样貌,并剔除冰、碎片和坏颗粒 → 建初始模型 → 3D classification → refinement → 用 gold-standard FSC = 0.143 判定分辨率。

对一个组装不完全的样品来说,起决定作用的一步是 3D classification:它能在计算上把组装完整和不完整的颗粒分开——晶体学做不到这一点,样品不均一时要么长不出晶体,要么只能得到一个被平均掉的模型。术语上还有一点要留神:亚基 subunit 是一条独立的多肽链,而结构域 domain 是一条链内可以独立折叠的单位。结构图上每个颜色通常是一个 domain,真正决定有没有四级结构的是亚基的数目。

heading_en: Proving the Enzyme Works, and Reading Assembly States out of 3D Classification
heading_zh: 如何证明酶有活性,以及从 3D classification 读出组装状态
en: The functional test is an extension assay: template, primer, substrate nucleotides and purified polymerase in one reaction, and a functional enzyme follows the template and extends the primer to complete the strand. The substrates have to be written correctly. A DNA polymerase — poxviruses are DNA viruses — uses dNTPs: dATP, dTTP, dGTP, dCTP. The RdRp of an RNA virus uses NTPs, and its product contains U, not T. The assay needs a free 3'-OH on the primer, since chains grow only 5' to 3', Mg2+ for two-metal-ion catalysis, and a readout, usually a fluorophore or a 32P label on the primer's 5' end, with products resolved by length on denaturing PAGE. The controls that matter are a no-enzyme reaction and a catalytic-site mutant with a conserved Asp changed to Ala, which together exclude a contaminating host polymerase.

Such a paper reaches Science because nobody had solved this virus's polymerase before, and the real bottleneck was that nobody had expressed and purified an active enzyme. The paper holds few figures and few experiments; the labour went into screening conditions, methods and buffers. Expression and purification remains close to alchemy — in a laboratory such as Gao Fu's, four or five people may be set on the same never-before-expressed protein, one or two succeed, and the others fail with essentially the same protocol.

3D classification sorts the imaged particles into classes, here four. Two of them, about 13% and 14% of the particles, lack density in the lower region; the other two show that region clearly. Those percentages are fractions of the particle count, reporting how many particles are in a given assembly state or conformation. They are neither a resolution nor a fraction of activity, and ice thickness, preferred orientation and picking bias all skew them, so they are qualitative evidence rather than a quantification.

Missing density has two possible readings: the subunit genuinely failed to assemble, or it assembled but is so flexible that averaging washed it out. The two look identical in the map, and separating them takes crosslinking mass spectrometry, SDS-PAGE of the sample, or biochemistry. Either way the lesson holds: the difficulty is the number of components, each of which must fold correctly and sit in the right environment for the complex to work.
zh: 功能验证做的是延伸实验 extension assay:模板 template、引物 primer、底物核苷酸和纯化好的聚合酶放进同一个体系,有功能的酶就会顺着 template、从 primer 往后把这条链补全。底物一定要写对:DNA 聚合酶(痘病毒是 DNA 病毒)用的是 dNTP,即 dATP、dTTP、dGTP、dCTP;RNA 病毒的 RdRp 用的是 NTP,即 ATP、UTP、GTP、CTP,产物里是 U 不是 T。这个实验还必须满足:引物有游离的 3'-OH(链只能 5'→3' 延伸)、体系里有 Mg2+ 以支持 two-metal-ion 催化、有检测手段(通常是引物 5' 端的荧光或 32P 标记),产物在变性 PAGE 上按长度分辨。真正关键的对照是不加酶的反应,以及催化位点突变体(保守 Asp 突成 Ala),两者合起来排除样品里污染的宿主聚合酶。

这样一篇文章能发 Science,是因为在此之前没有人解析过这个病毒的 polymerase,而真正的难点是没有人表达纯化出有活性的酶。文章本身图不多、实验也不多,工作量全在摸条件上:要试不同的方法、不同的 buffer。蛋白表达纯化到今天仍然很玄学,靠的是经验和不断试错——像高福院士那样的实验室,会同时派四五个人做同一个没人表达过的蛋白,最后可能只有一两个经验丰富或运气好的人做出来,别人照着基本相同的方法就是做不出来。

3D classification 把拍到的所有颗粒分成若干类,这里是四类。其中两类,约占 13% 和 14%,下面一段的密度是缺失的;另外两类下面这一段则很清楚。这些百分比是颗粒数的占比,反映样品里处于某个组装状态或构象的颗粒有多少。它既不是分辨率也不是活性比例,而且冰层厚度、取向偏好 preferred orientation、挑颗粒的偏差都会影响这些数字,所以只能当作定性证据,不能当作严格的定量。
密度缺失同样有两种读法:这个亚基或结构域真的没有组装上去,或者它组装上了但高度柔性,在多颗粒平均时被抹平了。两者在图上长得一模一样,要区分开必须靠交联质谱 XL-MS、样品的 SDS-PAGE 组分分析或者生化实验。但无论是哪一种,结论都成立:难就难在组分多。做出一个蛋白已经不容易,这里还要保证每个组分都正确折叠,并且都处在恰当的环境里,才能形成一个有功能的复合物。

heading_en: Resolution Limits and the Classical Methods for Higher-Order Structure
heading_zh: 分辨率极限与测定蛋白高级结构的经典方法
en: The methods gathered here are the older, textbook ones, and the place to start is why an ordinary light microscope resolves nothing below about 0.2 micrometre. That limit is diffraction physics rather than poor engineering: the Abbe criterion d = lambda / (2 x NA), with visible light between 400 and 700 nm and an oil-immersion objective of numerical aperture about 1.4, gives roughly 200 nm, and smaller molecules are simply invisible. Super-resolution methods — STED, PALM, STORM — get past the limit by switching fluorophores on and off and localising them one at a time, not by using shorter wavelengths.

The classical way round the wavelength problem is X-ray diffraction. One angstrom is 0.1 nanometre, and the sources used in practice sit at about 1.0 to 1.54 angstrom, Cu K-alpha being 1.54. Real protein crystal structures are typically solved at 1.5 to 3 angstrom; seeing actual hydrogen atoms requires atomic resolution better than about 1.0 angstrom, which is rare, and the hydrogens drawn in a routine structure are added by geometry rather than observed. The resolution achieved depends on the quality of the diffraction data and the order of the crystal, not on the wavelength of the source. X-ray remains one of the higher-resolution methods available.

NMR is the other classical route to higher-order structure, and it works directly in solution, which is its great advantage. It detects hydrogen and carbon signals, so a large protein produces too many of them to assign; the practical limit is around 30 to 40 kDa, extendable with deuteration and TROSY. It is demanding and used less often, but its unique value is that it gives conformational ensembles and dynamics, which crystallography cannot see.

Beyond these come methods that give no three-dimensional structure but do report on composition: UV absorbance, fluorescence, and circular dichroism, which rests on the same principles. CD measures the proportions of secondary structure — what percentage of a protein is alpha helix and what percentage beta sheet — and nothing more: no atomic coordinates and no indication of which segment is helical. The far-UV region, 190 to 250 nm, reports backbone conformation, with twin minima at 208 and 222 nm for alpha helix, a single minimum near 218 nm for beta sheet and one near 195 nm for random coil; the near-UV region, 250 to 320 nm, reports the environment of aromatic side chains and so whether tertiary structure is folded. The list is genuinely dated: large complexes and membrane proteins now go to cryo-EM, which needs no crystals and routinely reaches 2 to 3 angstrom, while AlphaFold supplies models — prediction, which does not replace experimental determination.
zh: 归在这里的方法都是比较古早的、书上的方法,而起点是:为什么常规光学显微镜看不到 0.2 微米以下的东西。这个极限是衍射决定的物理极限,不是仪器做工不够:Abbe 判据 d = lambda / (2 x NA),可见光波长 400 到 700 nm,油镜数值孔径 NA 约 1.4,代入正好得到约 200 nm,比这更小的分子就根本看不见。超分辨显微镜——STED、PALM、STORM——是靠把荧光分子逐个点亮、熄灭并精确定位来绕过这个极限的,而不是靠更短的波长。

绕开波长限制的经典办法是 X 射线衍射 X-ray diffraction。1 埃 angstrom 等于 0.1 纳米,实际使用的光源波长大约在 1.0 到 1.54 埃之间,Cu K-alpha 是 1.54 埃。真实的蛋白晶体结构常见分辨率是 1.5 到 3 埃;要真正看到氢原子,需要优于约 1.0 埃的原子分辨率,现实中很少见,常规结构里画出来的氢原子是按几何关系计算加上去的,不是观测到的。最终达到的分辨率取决于衍射数据的质量和晶体的有序程度,并不等于光源的波长。X 射线仍然是目前分辨率比较高的方法之一。
另一条测定高级结构的经典路线是核磁共振 NMR,它可以直接在溶液里测,这是它最大的好处。它检测的是氢原子和碳原子的信号,蛋白一旦太大,信号太多就难以归属;实用的分子量上限大约是 30 到 40 kDa,用氘代标记和 TROSY 技术还能往上推。这个方法比较难、用得也比较少,但它独有的价值是能给出构象系综和动力学信息,而这是晶体学看不到的。

再往后是一些给不出三维结构、但能大概知道组成的方法:紫外吸收 UV、荧光 fluorescence,以及基于同样原理的圆二色谱 circular dichroism(CD)。CD 测的是二级结构的含量比例——一个蛋白里 alpha helix 和 beta sheet 各占百分之多少——仅此而已:它不给任何原子坐标,也不告诉你哪一段是螺旋。远紫外区 190 到 250 nm 反映主链构象,alpha helix 在 208 nm 和 222 nm 有双负峰,beta sheet 在约 218 nm 有单负峰,无规卷曲在约 195 nm 有负峰;近紫外区 250 到 320 nm 反映芳香族侧链所处的环境,可用来判断三级结构是否折叠好。这份清单确实偏古早:今天大复合物和膜蛋白基本交给冷冻电镜 cryo-EM,它不需要结晶,常规能到 2 到 3 埃;而 AlphaFold 一类工具给出的是模型,是预测,预测不能替代实验测定。

heading_en: The Weak Interactions That Hold a Fold Together, and the Place of the Disulfide Bond
heading_zh: 维持三维结构的弱相互作用,以及二硫键该归到哪一级
en: Three-dimensional protein structure is held together mainly by weak interactions, that is by non-covalent forces; covalent bonds count as the strong interactions, and everything other than a covalent bond is grouped as weak. The orders of magnitude are worth carrying in the head: covalent bonds 200 to 450 kJ/mol, with C-C about 348 and S-S about 250; hydrogen bonds 4 to 20 kJ/mol; van der Waals contacts 0.4 to 4 kJ/mol. First among the weak forces is the salt bridge, also called an ionic bond, formed between one positively and one negatively charged atom — in biochemistry typically a nitrogen carrying the positive charge and an oxygen the negative.

An ion pair is enormously strong in vacuum, but the dielectric constant of water, about 80, screens it heavily and forming the bridge costs desolvation, so a salt bridge exposed on the surface often nets only a few kJ/mol and can even be destabilising, while one buried in the low-dielectric core is much stronger; whether it is worth ten hydrogen bonds depends on where it sits. Pure electrostatics has no directionality, but a salt bridge as structural biology defines it almost always satisfies hydrogen-bond geometry as well, the usual criterion being a charged nitrogen-to-oxygen distance of 4 angstrom or less; the strongly directional interaction is the hydrogen bond, strongest as D-H...A approaches 180 degrees.

Hydrogen bonds matter through their number, thousands where salt bridges number tens. Even so, the largest single contribution to folding a globular protein comes from the hydrophobic effect, and the mechanism is entropic: non-polar side chains exposed to water force the surrounding molecules into ordered cages, and burying them in the core releases that water, so solvent entropy rises and the free-energy change is driven negative. Each intramolecular hydrogen bond formed on folding costs a hydrogen bond to water, so the net gain per bond is small. Van der Waals forces are weakest individually, though they add up in a tightly packed core.

The disulfide bond stands apart because it is covalent. It forms by oxidation of two cysteine thiols and needs an oxidising compartment: the endoplasmic reticulum with PDI in eukaryotes, the periplasm with the Dsb system in bacteria. The reducing cytoplasm, full of glutathione, leaves cytoplasmic proteins essentially without disulfides, which is why secreted proteins expressed in the E. coli cytoplasm so often end up in inclusion bodies. Interchain disulfides, such as an antibody's heavy-light links, stabilise quaternary structure.

Asked which level of structure the disulfide belongs to, the Chinese textbook answer is the primary and the tertiary: primary by convention, since primary structure is defined as the sequence plus the positions of the disulfide bonds, which does not change the order in which residues are linked; not secondary, since alpha helix, beta sheet and random coil do not involve disulfides; tertiary, because that is where disulfides normally act. Many English texts instead restrict primary structure to the sequence and assign disulfide effects to tertiary or quaternary structure, so in English it is safest to specify intrachain versus interchain.
zh: 维持蛋白三维结构的主要是弱相互作用 weak interactions,也就是非共价力;共价键才算强相互作用,除共价键以外的作用都归到弱相互作用里。几个数量级值得记住:共价键约 200 到 450 kJ/mol,其中 C-C 约 348、S-S 约 250;氢键 hydrogen bond 约 4 到 20 kJ/mol;范德华作用 van der Waals 约 0.4 到 4 kJ/mol。弱相互作用里排第一的是盐桥 salt bridge,也叫离子键 ionic bond,它发生在一个带正电荷的原子和一个带负电荷的原子之间——生物化学里一般是氮带正电、氧带负电。

离子对在真空中能量极大,但水的介电常数约为 80,会强烈屏蔽它,再加上形成盐桥必须先脱去水化壳,所以暴露在蛋白表面的盐桥净贡献常常只有几 kJ/mol,有时甚至是不稳定因素;而埋在低介电的疏水核心里的盐桥则明显更强。所以它到底抵不抵得上十个氢键,要看它长在哪里。纯静电作用确实没有方向性,但结构生物学定义的盐桥几乎总是同时满足氢键几何,常用判据是带电的氮与氧之间距离小于等于 4 埃;真正具有强方向性的是氢键,D-H...A 越接近 180 度越强。

氢键之所以重要,靠的是数量:一个蛋白里氢键可能上千,而盐桥只有几十个。即便如此,对球状蛋白折叠贡献最大的单一因素仍然是疏水作用 hydrophobic effect,而且机制是熵驱动的:非极性侧链暴露在水中时,会迫使周围的水分子排成有序的笼状结构,把这些侧链埋进核心可以释放这些水,溶剂熵增,自由能变化因而被推向负值。折叠时形成的每一个链内氢键,都要以打断一个与水的氢键为代价,所以单个氢键的净收益有限。范德华力单个来看最弱,不过在堆积紧密的核心里累加起来也不可忽略。

二硫键 disulfide bond 单独成一类,因为它是共价键。它由两个半胱氨酸 cysteine 的巯基氧化生成,需要氧化性的区室:真核在内质网 ER 里由 PDI 催化,细菌在周质 periplasm 里由 Dsb 系统催化。细胞质是还原环境,充满谷胱甘肽 GSH,胞质蛋白因此几乎没有二硫键——这正是分泌型蛋白在大肠杆菌胞质中表达时常常形成包涵体的原因。链间二硫键,比如抗体的重链-轻链、重链-重链连接,则起到稳定四级结构的作用。

问二硫键影响蛋白质的哪一级结构,中文教材的答案是一级和三级。算一级是定义约定:一级结构 = 氨基酸序列 + 二硫键的位置,而这个键并不改变氨基酸连接的先后顺序,所以这是定义上的归类,不是重排。不算二级,是因为二级结构就是 alpha helix、beta sheet 和无规卷曲那几种,都不涉及二硫键。算三级,是因为二硫键通常正是在这一层次上起作用。很多英文教材则只把序列算作一级结构,而把二硫键的贡献归到三级或四级,所以用英文答题时最稳妥的做法是写清楚它是链内 intrachain 还是链间 interchain。

heading_en: The Planar Peptide Bond, the Phi and Psi Dihedral Angles, and the Ramachandran Plot
heading_zh: 肽键平面、phi/psi 二面角与 Ramachandran 拉氏图
en: An important constraint operates at the tertiary level: the polypeptide main chain is restricted in space and cannot twist arbitrarily. The peptide bond itself lies in a plane, because resonance gives the C-N bond about 40% double-bond character — shorter than an ordinary C-N single bond, longer than C=N, and not free to rotate. Six atoms are therefore coplanar: the two flanking C-alpha atoms together with C, O, N and H. That torsion, called omega, is normally close to 180 degrees, the trans arrangement. The bonds outside the peptide bond do rotate, which leaves each residue exactly two main-chain degrees of freedom, the dihedral angles phi, rotation about N-C-alpha, and psi, rotation about C-alpha-C.

Careful measurement established that these two angles must conform to the Ramachandran plot, drawn with psi on the vertical axis and phi on the horizontal, and every residue on the main chain has to fall within certain regions of it. Pale areas mark combinations the dihedral can twist into under special circumstances, the allowed region; red marks the favoured region, where the dihedral is at low energy. The forbidden regions are not a mysterious rule but plain hard-sphere sterics: certain phi/psi combinations make the carbonyl oxygen, the amide NH and the C-beta atoms of adjacent peptide planes collide. That is why the allowed area covers only about a quarter of the (phi, psi) plane for non-glycine residues — Ramachandran derived the plot from a hard-sphere model, before the experimental statistics existed.

Three landmark coordinates are worth memorising, since a question may hand over a (phi, psi) pair and ask which secondary structure it belongs to: the right-handed alpha helix at about (-57, -47), lower-left quadrant; the antiparallel beta sheet at about (-139, +135), upper left; the left-handed alpha helix at about (+57, +47), the small upper-right island, occupied almost exclusively by glycine. Two residues are special. Glycine's side chain is a single hydrogen, so steric hindrance is minimal and its allowed region much larger, reaching areas forbidden to everything else, which is why validation software plots glycine on a Ramachandran diagram of its own. Proline's side chain loops back onto the backbone nitrogen, locking phi near -60 plus or minus 25 degrees; it is the classic helix breaker, often found at turns.

Underneath all of this lies one principle: the conformation a chain adopts is the one of lowest free energy. A strained, high-energy conformation has to be paid for with extra work to maintain, so unless something compensates, the system relaxes spontaneously into a lower-energy arrangement — which, on the plot, means the favoured regions.
zh: 三级结构里有一条重要限制:多肽主链在空间上是受限的,不能任意扭转。肽键 peptide bond 本身处在一个平面上,因为 C-N 之间存在共振,带有约 40% 的双键性质——键长比普通 C-N 单键短、比 C=N 长,不能自由旋转。于是有六个原子共面:两侧的 C-alpha,加上 C、O、N、H。这个转角叫 omega,通常接近 180 度,即 trans 构型。肽键以外的那些键则可以转动,这就使每个残基的主链恰好剩下两个自由度,即二面角 dihedral angle:phi 是绕 N-C-alpha 的旋转,psi 是绕 C-alpha-C 的旋转。

精细的测定确立了一件事:这两个角必须符合 Ramachandran plot(拉氏图)。这张图纵坐标是 psi、横坐标是 phi,主链上每一个残基都必须落在图上的某些区域内。淡色区代表这个二面角在特殊情况下可以扭转到的位置,即允许区 allowed;红色区代表比较 favorable 的区域,二面角落在这里时能量比较低。禁区不是什么神秘规则,就是硬球位阻:某些 phi/psi 组合会让相邻肽平面上的羰基氧、酰胺 NH 和 C-beta 原子相互碰撞。这也是为什么对非甘氨酸残基来说,允许区只占整个 (phi, psi) 平面的约四分之一——Ramachandran 当年正是用硬球模型算出这张图的,并不是先有实验统计。

有三个地标坐标值得背下来,因为考题可能直接给一组 (phi, psi) 让你判断是哪种二级结构:右手 alpha helix 约在 (-57, -47),位于左下象限;反平行 beta sheet 约在 (-139, +135),位于左上象限;左手 alpha helix 约在 (+57, +47),是右上角那个小岛,几乎只有甘氨酸能占据。另有两个特殊残基。甘氨酸 Gly 的侧链只是一个氢,空间位阻最小,允许区大得多,能进入别的残基进不去的区域,所以结构验证软件通常把 Gly 单独画一张拉氏图。脯氨酸 Pro 的侧链环回到主链氮上,把 phi 锁定在约 -60 度正负 25 度,是典型的螺旋终止子 helix breaker,常出现在转角处。
这一切背后只有一条道理:多肽链最终采取的构象是自由能最低的那一个。一个应变的、高能量的构象需要额外做功去维持,所以只要没有别的补偿,体系就会自发弛豫到能量更低的排布——落在图上,就是那些 favorable 的区域。

heading_en: Refinement, Ramachandran Outliers, and the Flexibility of Loops
heading_zh: 结构精修、Ramachandran outlier 与 loop 区的柔性
en: Phi and psi matter a great deal in practical structural work, because once a structure has been solved there is a step called refinement, and refinement mainly adjusts two things: the orientation of the side chains, and the phi and psi angles. An outlier is a phi/psi pair that has fallen outside the allowed region, into the unfavourable zone. Current standards, as applied by MolProbity and the PDB validation servers, are strict: at least 98% of residues in the favoured region, outliers at most about 0.05%, and effectively none in a high-resolution structure. Alongside these one checks the clashscore, the fraction of side-chain rotamer outliers, and, for crystallography, R and R_free, whose gap should generally stay within about five percentage points.

Even a structure refined well and accepted by a validation server can retain a couple of outliers, and where they sit is informative. A point lying quite close to the allowed region often belongs to a residue in a loop, an amorphous stretch that is neither alpha helix nor beta sheet and in which the software sees no secondary structure at all. The explanation is that residues constrain and coordinate one another, and it is that mutual coordination which keeps all the phi/psi values in good regions; a residue on a flexible loop swings easily and is readily pushed about by solvent water molecules, so it is far more likely to end up in a poor region.

Loops behave this way because no regular hydrogen-bond network locks their backbone: B-factors are high, density is weak, and several conformations often coexist — in an NMR ensemble the same loop is drawn as a spread of different paths. Coordinates in a loop, and any conclusion built on them, such as whether a particular site takes part in binding, therefore deserve caution. Conversely, it is exactly this flexibility that makes loops such frequent substrate-binding, allosteric and antibody-recognition sites.

None of which means every outlier should be forced into the favoured region. Rotating the bond at such a residue changes phi and psi together, and a very small rotation can bring it back to the ideal position — while creating extra repulsion with its neighbour, which is often reason enough to leave it alone. At modest resolution the density does not uniquely determine backbone angles either, and forcing a perfect Ramachandran plot injects the model's prior into the data; that is over-fitting, and it shows up as R_free failing to fall or rising. Genuine outliers can be meaningful too: active-site residues often sit in strained conformations paid for by binding energy, and that strain is part of the catalysis rather than something to be smoothed away. Throughout, the quantity minimised is the Gibbs free energy, delta G = delta H - T x delta S, not energy alone: folding lowers the chain's own conformational entropy and proceeds only because the solvent entropy released by the hydrophobic effect more than repays it.
zh: phi 角和 psi 角在实际的结构工作里特别重要,因为解析出结构之后还有一步叫精修 refinement,而精修主要调整两样东西:侧链的朝向,以及 phi 角和 psi 角。所谓 outlier,就是落到允许区之外、进入 unfavorable 区域的那些 phi/psi。现在通行的标准,即 MolProbity 和 PDB validation 采用的标准,相当严格:Ramachandran favored 应达到 98% 以上,outlier 应在约 0.05% 以下,高分辨率结构基本要求一个都没有。与之并列要看的还有 clashscore(原子碰撞数)、侧链 rotamer outlier 的比例,以及晶体学的 R 与 R_free,两者差值通常不宜超过约 5 个百分点。

即便是一个已经修得比较好、并被验证服务器接受的结构,也可能还留着一两个 outlier,而它们出现在什么位置本身就有信息。一个已经比较贴近允许区的点,往往属于处在 loop 区的残基——那是一段既不是 alpha helix 也不是 beta sheet 的无定形区域,软件在这里根本看不到二级结构。解释在于:氨基酸之间是相互制约、相互协调的,正是这种协调才让所有 phi/psi 都落在良好区间;而柔性 loop 上的残基很容易摆动,也容易受到溶剂水分子的推挤,所以更容易落进不良区域。
loop 之所以如此,是因为没有规则的氢键网络把它的主链锁住:B 因子(温度因子)高、密度弱,常常有多个构象共存——在 NMR 的结构系综里,同一段 loop 会画出一大把不同的走向。因此 loop 区的原子坐标,以及任何建立在这些坐标上的结论(比如某个位点是否参与结合),都要留余地。反过来,恰恰是这种柔性让 loop 常常成为底物结合位点、变构位点和抗体识别位点。

但这并不意味着应该把每一个 outlier 都强推进 favorable 区。旋转这个残基处的那根键,phi 和 psi 会同时改变,只要稍微转一点点就能把它送回理想位置——可回去以后又可能跟旁边的残基产生额外的互斥,这往往就足以成为不去动它的理由。而且在分辨率不高时,电子密度或 EM 密度本身并不足以唯一确定主链角度,强行修出一张完美的拉氏图,等于把模型的先验偏见塞进数据里,那属于 over-fitting,表现为 R_free 不降反升。真正的 outlier 有时也有意义:酶活性中心的残基常常处于应变构象 strained conformation,这份张力由结合能补偿,是催化的一部分,不该被抹平。归根到底,体系走向最低的是 Gibbs 自由能,delta G = delta H - T x delta S,而不是单看能量最低:折叠本身让多肽链的构象熵下降,之所以还能自发进行,是因为疏水作用释放有序水带来的溶剂熵增补偿有余。

heading_en: The Amide Plane, the Definition of Secondary Structure, and alpha-Helix Geometry
heading_zh: 酰胺平面、二级结构的定义与 α helix 的几何
en: The atoms of a peptide bond are coplanar; that rigid unit is the amide plane, and a polypeptide is a string of such planes joined end to end. Rotation is possible only about the two bonds that link one plane to the next, and the torsion angles about them, phi and psi, can be read as the dihedral angles between two neighbouring amide planes. Changing them is never a local act: it perturbs non-covalent interactions elsewhere, because every atom in a protein constrains every other, and side-chain contacts in turn hold phi and psi where they are. On the Ramachandran plot the coordinates worth memorising are the right-handed alpha-helix at phi about -57 degrees and psi about -47 degrees, the antiparallel beta-sheet near -140 and +135 degrees, and the left-handed alpha-helix at +57 and +47 degrees, a region normally open only to glycine.

Secondary structure is strictly defined as a local, regular conformation of the backbone, and only the alpha-helix and the beta-sheet qualify; essentially all regular secondary structure in nature belongs to these two classes. That is not to say they fill the protein. In a typical globular protein only about 50 to 60 per cent of residues sit in regular secondary structure, the rest being turns and loops. In human proteins the helix is always right-handed, because natural proteins are built from L-amino acids and the L configuration dictates the handedness; some bacteria do incorporate D-amino acids and can form left-handed helices.

The geometry rests on two numbers. One full turn rises about 0.54 nm along the axis, a pitch of 5.4 A, and each residue advances about 0.15 nm, 1.5 A, so the helix has 3.6 residues per turn. The backbone hydrogen bonding runs i to i+4: the C=O of residue i bonds to the N-H of residue i+4, closing a thirteen-atom ring, which is why the helix is also written 3.6-13. The i to i+3 pattern is the 3-10 helix and i to i+5 the pi helix; both exist but are rare and usually only cap the ends of an alpha-helix. All this bonding is buried inside the helix, running down the axis, while every side chain points outward. That outward display is why alpha-helices make such good recognition surfaces, and why the regions through which an antibody contacts its antigen are often a few stretches of helix.
zh: 组成肽键的那一组原子是共平面的，这个刚性单元叫酰胺平面 amide plane，而一条多肽链就是一串首尾相接的平面。能转动的只有连接相邻两个平面的那两根键，绕它们的扭转角 φ 和 ψ 可以看成相邻两个酰胺平面之间的二面角 dihedral angle。改变它们从来不是局部动作：它会扰动别处的非共价相互作用 non-covalent interactions，因为蛋白里每个原子都在制约别的原子，而侧链间的相互作用反过来又把 φ/ψ 固定在原处。拉氏图 Ramachandran plot 上值得背下的坐标是：右手 α helix 在 φ ≈ −57°、ψ ≈ −47°；反平行 β sheet 在 −140°、+135° 附近；左手 α helix 在 +57°、+47°，那个区域正常只对甘氨酸 glycine 开放。

二级结构 secondary structure 的严格定义是主链局部的、有规律的构象，够格的只有 α helix 和 β sheet；自然界中几乎所有规则二级结构都属于这两类。但这不等于说它们占满了整个蛋白。在典型的球状蛋白里，只有约 50%–60% 的残基处于规则二级结构中，其余是 turn 和 loop。人体蛋白中的螺旋一定是右手的，因为天然蛋白由 L 型氨基酸 L-amino acids 构成，L 构型决定了旋向；某些细菌确实能掺入 D 型氨基酸 D-amino acids，因而可以形成左手螺旋。

几何由两个数决定。每上升一整圈约 0.54 nm，即螺距 pitch 5.4 Å；每个氨基酸沿轴上升约 0.15 nm，即 1.5 Å，因此螺旋每圈 3.6 个残基。主链氢键的编号是 i → i+4：第 i 位残基的 C=O 与第 i+4 位残基的 N–H 成氢键，闭合成一个 13 元环，所以 α helix 也写作 3.6₁₃。i → i+3 是 3₁₀ helix，i → i+5 是 π helix，两者都存在但少见，通常只作为 α helix 两端的帽子。所有这些氢键都埋在螺旋内部、沿轴自上而下，而每一个侧链都朝向外部。正是这种侧链外向的排布使 α helix 成为极好的识别表面，也是为什么抗体接触抗原的区域常常就是几段螺旋。

heading_en: Which Residues Enter an alpha-Helix: Glycine and Proline as Helix Breakers
heading_zh: 哪些氨基酸能进 α helix：作为 helix breaker 的甘氨酸与脯氨酸
en: The residues that build an alpha-helix are typically those with small, largely uncharged side chains; alanine, valine and isoleucine are the standard examples. Along the helix the side chains of neighbouring residues bump against and constrain one another, and that lateral packing is part of what pins the structure in place. Two residues stand out as the poorest helix formers, the classic helix breakers: glycine and proline. Helix propensity runs roughly Ala > Leu > Met > Glu > Gln and on down to Gly and finally Pro, alanine the best and proline the worst.

Proline is the more disruptive, and it has two reasons. First, and decisively, its nitrogen is locked inside the five-membered pyrrolidine ring as a secondary amine, so the backbone there carries no N-H at all and cannot donate a hydrogen bond; one rung of the i to i+4 ladder is simply missing. Second, the ring fixes phi at about -60 degrees, stripping the backbone of the freedom to adopt helical torsion angles. Glycine destabilises a helix for the opposite kind of reason. Its side chain is a single hydrogen atom, too small to make any contact with its neighbours, but the better justification is thermodynamic: with no C-beta it samples the largest accessible region of the Ramachandran plot, so the unfolded chain has a high conformational entropy at that position and folding it into a helix costs more entropy than for any other residue.

Neither exclusion is absolute; never is a mnemonic, not a fact. Proline is in fact common in the first turn of a helix and at the N-cap, precisely where there is no i-4 partner to bond with anyway, so the missing N-H costs nothing, and inside a transmembrane helix it produces a characteristic kink of roughly 20 degrees, as in the G-protein coupled receptors. Its usual home, though, lies elsewhere: the beta-turn treated next and loop regions generally, where a built-in bend is exactly what is wanted.
zh: 构成 α helix 的一般是侧链比较小、带电荷比较少的氨基酸，标准例子是丙氨酸 alanine、缬氨酸 valine 和异亮氨酸 isoleucine。沿着螺旋，相邻残基的侧链会互相碰撞、互相制约，这种侧向堆积也是把结构固定住的因素之一。有两个残基是公认最差的成螺旋者，即经典的 helix breaker：甘氨酸 glycine 和脯氨酸 proline。螺旋倾向 helix propensity 大致排序为 Ala > Leu > Met > Glu > Gln … 一路到 Gly，最后是 Pro，丙氨酸最好，脯氨酸最差。

脯氨酸破坏性更强，理由有两条。第一条也是决定性的：它的氮原子被锁在五元吡咯烷环里，是仲胺，因此该位置的主链上根本没有 N–H，无法作为氢键供体，i → i+4 这个氢键梯子上就缺了一格。第二条：环把 φ 角锁死在约 −60°，剥夺了主链摆出螺旋扭转角的自由度。甘氨酸使螺旋不稳则是相反性质的原因。它的侧链只是一个氢原子，小到与邻居几乎没有任何接触；但更标准的解释是热力学的：没有 Cβ，它在拉氏图上可及的区域最大，该位置在展开态时构象熵极高，把它折进螺旋所付出的熵代价比任何其他残基都大。
这两条排除都不是绝对的——「绝对不会有」是记忆口号，不是事实。脯氨酸实际上常见于螺旋的第一圈和 N 端帽 N-cap，那里本来就没有 i−4 的氢键伙伴，缺一个 N–H 并不吃亏；在跨膜螺旋中它会造成一个约 20° 的 kink，如 GPCR 中的 proline kink。不过它最常见的去处在别处：接下来要讲的 β 转角 β-turn 和各种 loop 区域——那里要的正是一个自带的折角。

heading_en: The beta-Sheet: Interstrand Hydrogen Bonds, Parallel versus Antiparallel, and the Hydrophobic Core
heading_zh: β sheet：链间氢键、平行与反平行、疏水腔
en: In older literature the beta-sheet appears as the beta pleated sheet, a sheet folded into pleats. It is defined as two or more fully extended polypeptide strands laid side by side and joined by lateral hydrogen bonds into one sheet. Those hydrogen bonds are purely backbone-to-backbone, the N-H of one strand to the C=O of the adjacent strand; the side chains take no part, projecting instead alternately above and below the plane of the sheet. Fully extended has a number attached to it: a strand advances about 3.3 to 3.5 A per residue, more than twice the 1.5 A of an alpha-helix.

Sheets come in two classes. In a parallel sheet the strands run the same way, in an antiparallel sheet in opposite directions, and the consequence is visible in the hydrogen bonds. Antiparallel bonds are almost linear and line up nearly perpendicular to the strands, so each bond is stronger and the sheet more stable; such a sheet may consist of only two strands, often produced by a beta-hairpin. Parallel bonds come in at a slant and are distorted, so parallel sheets are less stable, generally need five strands or more, and tend to be buried. Recognising a structure as a beta-sheet is usually the level of detail asked for, but this classification is standard and should be known.

The most important thing a beta-sheet does is build a hydrophobic core: one face of a sheet may be made entirely of leucine, valine, isoleucine and phenylalanine. Because consecutive side chains along a strand point to opposite faces, such a face is produced simply by placing hydrophobic residues at every second sequence position, i, i+2, i+4. The contrast with the helix is a standard tool for reading sequences: with 3.6 residues per turn, an amphipathic helix carries its hydrophobic residues every three to four positions instead. The classic arrangement is two layers of sheet facing each other and enclosing a whole hydrophobic cavity, very rigid and a typical structural domain; the outward face may be hydrophobic or hydrophilic, depending on the sequence.

Sheets can also form between molecules. The core of an amyloid fibril is a cross-beta structure in which interstrand hydrogen bonds link separate protein molecules into one indefinitely extended sheet, as in the A-beta of Alzheimer disease, the prions and islet amyloid polypeptide. The other arrangement worth knowing is the beta-barrel: porins in the Gram-negative outer membrane roll a sheet into a closed barrel with a hydrophobic outside and a hydrophilic lumen, the inverse of a globular protein.
zh: 在比较古早的文献里 β sheet 叫 β pleated sheet，即折成褶皱的片层。它的定义是：两条或多条完全伸展 fully extended 的肽链并排放置，通过侧向氢键连成一个片层。这些氢键完全是主链 backbone 之间的，一条链的 N–H 与相邻链的 C=O；侧链不参与，而是交替伸向片层的上下两面。「完全伸展」是有数字的：β 链每个残基沿链方向推进约 3.3–3.5 Å，是 α helix 那 1.5 Å 的两倍多。

片层分两类。平行 parallel 时两条链走向一致，反平行 antiparallel 时走向相反，后果体现在氢键上。反平行的氢键接近直线，且基本与链垂直对齐，因此单键更强、片层更稳定，可以只有两条链，常由 β 发夹 β-hairpin 形成。平行的氢键是斜过来的、被扭曲，稳定性较差，通常需要五条链以上，而且多埋在蛋白内部。考试里一般认出「这是 β sheet」就够了，但这个分类是教科书标准内容，应当知道。

β sheet 最重要的功能是构建疏水腔 hydrophobic core：片层的一面可以全部由亮氨酸 leucine、缬氨酸 valine、异亮氨酸 isoleucine、苯丙氨酸 phenylalanine 构成。由于 β 链上相邻残基的侧链交替指向两面，这样一个疏水面只需在序列上每隔一个残基放一个疏水氨基酸，即 i、i+2、i+4。与螺旋的对比是判读序列的常用工具：α helix 每圈 3.6 个残基，所以两亲螺旋 amphipathic helix 的疏水残基是每隔 3–4 位出现一次。经典安排是两层 β sheet 相对，围出一整个疏水腔，刚性很强，构成一个典型的结构域；朝外的那一面可以是疏水的也可以是亲水的，取决于序列。
β sheet 也可以跨分子形成。淀粉样纤维 amyloid fibril 的核心就是 cross-β 结构：链间氢键把不同的蛋白分子连成一根可以无限延伸的 β sheet，见于阿尔茨海默病的 Aβ、朊病毒 prion 和胰岛淀粉样多肽。另一个值得知道的排布是 β barrel：革兰阴性菌外膜的孔蛋白 porin 把片层卷成闭合的桶，外面疏水、内腔亲水，与球状蛋白正好相反。

heading_en: beta-Turns, Flexible Loops and the Misnamed Random Coil
heading_zh: β 转角、flexible loop 与名不副实的无规卷曲
en: The beta-turn is also classed as secondary structure, though it is rarely emphasised. It deserves its own treatment because it is the exact counterpart of the alpha-helix: a helix essentially excludes glycine and proline, the two residues of lowest helix propensity, whereas a beta-turn in most cases contains precisely those two. Its definition is tighter than a mere change of direction: four residues, i to i+3, with a hydrogen bond from the C=O of residue i to the N-H of residue i+3, the alpha-carbons of i and i+3 less than 7 A apart, and the chain reversing by about 180 degrees.

The two residues divide the labour. Proline carries a built-in bend, folding the carboxyl end down relative to the amino end, so a peptide bond formed there produces a turn automatically; in the common type I turn proline usually sits at i+1. Glycine contributes the opposite property, a minimal side chain that imposes no steric hindrance on its neighbours and is easily accommodated in a cramped turn; in a type II turn glycine is obligatory at i+2, because the conformation demanded there can be adopted only by a residue with no C-beta. Packing four large side chains, hydrophobic ones especially, into so tight a space would set up severe repulsion and is far from the lowest-energy state.

A stretch of chain can reverse by 180 degrees and still not be a beta-turn: if it contains neither glycine nor proline and no hydrogen bond holds it, it is simply an unstructured region. The criterion is worth stating explicitly. A beta-turn is held in shape actively, by rigidity or a specific interaction, whereas an unstructured region has no defining force of its own and its shape is imposed passively by its surroundings. In practice structural biologists rarely say unstructured; the working term is flexible loop.

A random coil is a segment with no structure at all, drifting flexibly in water, still dictated by the primary structure in that its sequence contains nothing able to form a helix or a sheet. The name misleads, however. Inside a folded protein such a region usually has a definite, reproducible conformation whose coordinates can be resolved in a crystal structure; it merely lacks a repeating pattern, so irregular is meant rather than random. A genuine random coil is a denatured chain, sampled at random across an ensemble. The omega loop belongs here too, a lasso in which the chain runs straight, bulges out and straightens again with its first and last alpha-carbons close together; catalogued in protein structures by Leszczynski and Rose in 1986, it is a common element, several to an average protein, often forming the lid over an enzyme active site or an antibody complementarity-determining region.

Turns and loops attract little discussion but are frequently the decisive parts of a protein: antibody CDRs are loops throughout, enzyme substrate specificity is set mainly by the loops around the active-site pocket, and protease sites, phosphorylation sites and degradation signals sit mostly on flexible loops. In a crystal structure these regions have the highest B-factors and may be missing altogether for want of electron density. Invisible in a structure does not mean absent; usually it means the opposite, that the segment is mobile.
zh: β 转角 β-turn 也被归为二级结构，只是平时很少被强调。它值得单独讲，因为它正是 α helix 的反面：α helix 基本排斥甘氨酸 glycine 和脯氨酸 proline 这两个螺旋倾向最低的残基，而 β 转角在大多数情况下恰恰含有这两个。它的定义比「拐个弯」严格：四个残基 i 到 i+3，第 i 位的 C=O 与第 i+3 位的 N–H 形成一个氢键，i 与 i+3 的 Cα 距离小于 7 Å，链的方向反转约 180°。

这两个残基有分工。脯氨酸自带一个折角，把羧基一端相对氨基一端折下去，在那里成肽键就自动产生一个转角；在常见的 type I 转角里，脯氨酸通常位于 i+1 位。甘氨酸提供相反的性质：侧链极小，对相邻氨基酸不产生空间位阻 steric hindrance，很容易被塞进狭窄的转角；而在 type II 转角中，甘氨酸在 i+2 位是必需的，因为那个位置要求的构象只有没有 Cβ 的残基才能采取。若把四个大的、尤其是疏水的侧链塞进这么紧的空间，它们之间会严重排斥，远不是能量最低的状态。

一段链可以转过 180° 却仍然不是 β 转角：如果它既不含甘氨酸也不含脯氨酸，也没有氢键把它固定住，那就只是一段 unstructured 区。这个判据值得明说：β 转角是被主动定型的，靠刚性或某种特定的相互作用；而 unstructured 区没有自己的维持力，形状是被周围因素被动决定的。实际上结构生物学口语里很少说 unstructured，通用的说法是 flexible loop 灵活环区。

无规卷曲 random coil 指完全没有结构、柔性地飘在水里的一段；它同样由一级结构决定——这段序列不含任何能形成 α helix 或 β sheet 的内容。不过这个名字骗人。在一个已折叠的蛋白里，这样的区域通常有确定、可重复的构象，晶体结构里能解出坐标；它缺的只是周期性的规律，所以应理解为「无规则」而不是「随机」。真正意义上的 random coil 是变性后的多肽链，构象在系综中随机采样。Ω 环 omega loop 也属于这一类：肽链直走—鼓出一个套索—再直走，首尾两个 Cα 靠得很近；Leszczynski 与 Rose 于 1986 年在蛋白结构中定义并统计，它是常见元件，平均每个蛋白有若干个，常常构成酶活性位点的盖子或抗体的互补决定区 CDR。
turn 和 loop 很少被提及，却常常是蛋白最关键的部分：抗体的抗原结合位点 CDR 全部是 loop，酶的底物特异性主要由活性口袋周围的 loop 决定，蛋白酶切位点、磷酸化位点和降解信号也大多位于柔性 loop 上。在晶体结构里，这些区域的 B 因子最高，甚至会因为没有电子密度而整段缺失。「结构里看不见」不等于「不存在」，通常正相反——它说明这一段很灵活。

heading_en: alpha-Keratin, Disulfide Cross-Links and the Chemistry of a Perm
heading_zh: α 角蛋白、二硫键交联与烫发的化学
en: One aside before going on. Classical biochemistry contains no chapter on photosynthesis, so never having studied it is normal; being asked about it in an oral examination is nonetheless awkward, and the C3 and C4 cycles and the Z-scheme of photosynthetic electron transfer are worth covering, difficult as that material is. Returning to structure: proteins can be classified by their secondary-structure content, and some consist almost entirely of alpha-helices. The classic case is keratin, which exists in an alpha and a beta form.

alpha-Keratin is built entirely from alpha-helices wound around one another, and human hair is the textbook example. The unit is a dimer: two right-handed alpha-helices wind about each other into a left-handed coiled coil, held by the hydrophobic residues at the a and d positions of a heptad repeat a-b-c-d-e-f-g, which interlock along the interface. Dimers then assemble into protofilaments, microfibrils and finally the hair shaft. alpha-Keratin is rich in cysteine, and those cysteines cross-link neighbouring helices through disulfide bonds; that covalent cross-linking is where hair gets its mechanical strength. beta-Keratin, by contrast, is built from beta-sheets and is found in silk fibroin, feathers and reptile scales.

A perm runs this chemistry deliberately. The first lotion is a reducing agent, usually ammonium thioglycolate, alkaline, which is why it smells of ammonia; it opens the disulfide bonds between the helices and the hair becomes very soft. The hair is shaped, and the second lotion, the neutraliser, is an oxidising agent, hydrogen peroxide or sodium bromate, which lets the opened disulfides re-form in the new, artificially imposed positions and locks in the style. Chemical straightening is the same chemistry with a different shaping step. The smell comes from the sulfur in these reagents; in the laboratory beta-mercaptoethanol is the worst offender and DTT is milder, DTT being the standard reagent for reducing disulfides, slightly toxic, and certainly not what goes on hair.

Newly grown hair is unaffected, which is why a perm grows out. Which cysteines pair with which is set by their positions in the primary structure and by the geometry with which the follicle extrudes the shaft; a perm changes neither, only the pairing, and only temporarily, so each new segment emerges in its original form. By the same logic natural curliness depends mainly on follicle cross-section and cross-link density, and is heritable. Disulfide bonds also require an oxidising environment: in eukaryotes they form in the lumen of the endoplasmic reticulum, catalysed by protein disulfide isomerase, while the cytosol is held reducing by glutathione and normally contains none. Hence secreted and extracellular proteins such as antibodies and insulin are disulfide-rich and cytosolic proteins are not, and hence DTT or beta-mercaptoethanol goes into SDS-PAGE sample buffer, precisely to break these bonds.
zh: 继续之前先插一句。经典生物化学里没有光合作用这一章，所以没学过是正常的；但口试时被问到会很被动，C3/C4 循环和光合电子传递的 Z 型（Z-scheme）还是值得补上，尽管这部分确实很难。回到结构：蛋白可以按二级结构组成分类，有些几乎全部由 α helix 构成，最典型的例子是角蛋白 keratin，它分 α 和 β 两种形式。

α 角蛋白 α-keratin 完全由相互缠绕的 α helix 构成，教科书例子是人的头发。基本单元是二聚体：两条右手 α helix 相互缠绕成一个左手的卷曲螺旋 coiled coil，靠七肽重复 heptad repeat a-b-c-d-e-f-g 中 a、d 两位的疏水残基沿界面咬合固定。二聚体再组装成原纤维 protofilament、微纤维 microfibril，最后形成发丝。α 角蛋白富含半胱氨酸 cysteine，这些 cysteine 在相邻螺旋之间形成交联的二硫键 disulfide bond；正是这种共价交联给了头发机械强度。相对地，β 角蛋白 β-keratin 由 β sheet 构成，见于蚕丝丝心蛋白 silk fibroin、羽毛和爬行动物鳞片。

烫发就是有意识地跑一遍这套化学。第一剂是还原剂 reducing agent，通常是巯基乙酸铵 ammonium thioglycolate，呈碱性，所以有氨味；它把螺旋之间的二硫键打开，头发变得非常软。定型之后，第二剂即「中和剂」是氧化剂 oxidizing agent，过氧化氢 H₂O₂ 或溴酸钠 sodium bromate，让打开的二硫键在人为改造过的新位置重新形成，发型就固定下来。直发膏用的是同一套化学，只是定型方向不同。气味来自这些试剂中的硫；实验室里巯基乙醇 β-mercaptoethanol 最臭，DTT 相对好一些，DTT 是还原二硫键的标准试剂，有微量毒性，用在头发上的肯定不是它。

新长出来的头发不受影响，这就是为什么烫发会「长出来」。哪几对半胱氨酸配对，取决于它们在一级结构上的位置以及毛囊挤出发丝时的几何；烫发这两样都没改变，只是临时换了一组配对关系，所以每一段新发都以原本的形态长出。同理，天然的卷直程度主要由毛囊截面形状和交联密度决定，是遗传性状。二硫键的形成还需要氧化环境：真核细胞中它们在内质网 ER 腔内由蛋白二硫键异构酶 PDI 催化形成，而胞质 cytosol 由谷胱甘肽 glutathione 维持还原状态，正常不含二硫键。因此抗体、胰岛素这类分泌蛋白和细胞外蛋白富含二硫键，而胞内蛋白很少；也因此 SDS-PAGE 上样缓冲液里要加 DTT 或 β-ME，正是为了拆掉这些键。

heading_en: Collagen: the Triple Helix, Hydroxylated Residues, and Why It Is an Incomplete Protein
heading_zh: 胶原蛋白：三股螺旋、羟基化氨基酸与不完全蛋白
en: Collagen is the principal protein of connective tissue: not a globular protein with a compact shape but a fibrous structural material. It is helical throughout, yet it is not built from classical alpha-helices. Each of its three strands is a left-handed polyproline II helix with about three residues per turn, far more extended than an alpha-helix, which is right-handed with 3.6 residues per turn; the three strands then wind into a right-handed superhelix, like three thin wires twisted into a cable whose own twist is right-handed. The comparison with alpha-keratin is easily muddled and worth fixing: keratin twists two right-handed helices into a left-handed coiled coil, collagen three left-handed helices into a right-handed superhelix. Opposite senses, and different strand counts.

The sequence is a strict (Gly-X-Y)n repeat, X often proline and Y often 4-hydroxyproline. Glycine is compulsory at every third position because the axis of the triple helix is so crowded that only a side chain the size of a hydrogen atom will fit. That is why collagen not merely tolerates but requires the very residues an ordinary alpha-helix cannot accommodate, and why the sequence has no tolerance for error: mutating a single glycine to any other residue wrecks the whole fibre, which is the molecular basis of osteogenesis imperfecta, brittle bone disease.

Hydroxyproline and hydroxylysine are not inserted by tRNA. Proline is incorporated normally and then modified after translation by prolyl-4-hydroxylase, an enzyme requiring Fe(II), alpha-ketoglutarate, oxygen and ascorbate; vitamin C acts by re-reducing the enzyme iron from Fe(III) back to Fe(II). Without it there is too little hydroxyproline, the interchain hydrogen-bond network is unstable, the melting temperature of the triple helix falls and the fibres become fragile: scurvy, with bleeding gums, wounds that will not heal and fragile vessels. A second, quite separate cross-linking pathway gives the fibre its strength, since collagen contains almost no cysteine and no disulfides. Lysyl oxidase, a copper enzyme, oxidises the side-chain amino groups of lysine and hydroxylysine to aldehydes, which condense spontaneously into covalent cross-links; these accumulate with age and stiffen the tissue, and copper deficiency likewise causes connective-tissue disease.

Finally a popular misconception: collagen is not a high-quality dietary protein. Nutritionally, a complete protein contains all the essential amino acids in adequate proportion. Collagen contains essentially no tryptophan at all, a peculiarity that historically served to identify it, and is poor in cysteine, tyrosine and methionine, so it is an incomplete protein. As a corollary, collagen taken by mouth is digested to amino acids and small peptides like any other protein; nothing routes it to the skin.
zh: 胶原蛋白 collagen 是结缔组织 connective tissue 的主要蛋白：不是有固定形状的球状蛋白，而是纤维状的结构材料。它通体是螺旋，却不是由经典的 α helix 构成。它的每一股都是左手的聚脯氨酸 II 型螺旋 polyproline II helix，每圈约 3 个残基，比 α helix 伸展得多——α helix 是右手、每圈 3.6 个残基；三股再拧成一个右手的超螺旋，像三根细电线拧成一根大电线，而这根大电线本身是右手旋的。与 α 角蛋白的对照最容易记串，值得钉住：角蛋白是两条右手螺旋拧成左手 coiled coil，胶原蛋白是三条左手螺旋拧成右手超螺旋。旋向相反，股数也不同。

序列是严格的 (Gly-X-Y)ₙ 重复，X 常为脯氨酸 Pro，Y 常为 4-羟脯氨酸 4-Hyp。甘氨酸每隔两位必须出现一次，因为三股螺旋的轴心极其拥挤，只有氢原子那么大的侧链才塞得进去。这就是为什么胶原蛋白不仅能容忍、而且必须依赖普通 α helix 恰恰无法容纳的那两种残基，也是为什么序列容不得差错：任何一个 Gly 被突变成别的残基都会破坏整根纤维，这正是成骨不全症 osteogenesis imperfecta（脆骨病）的分子基础。

羟脯氨酸 hydroxyproline 和羟赖氨酸 hydroxylysine 不是由 tRNA 掺入的。脯氨酸先正常掺入，随后由脯氨酰-4-羟化酶 prolyl-4-hydroxylase 做翻译后修饰；该酶需要 Fe²⁺、α-酮戊二酸 α-ketoglutarate、O₂ 和抗坏血酸 ascorbate，维生素 C 的作用是把酶中被氧化的 Fe³⁺ 还原回 Fe²⁺。缺了它，羟脯氨酸不足，链间氢键网络不稳，三股螺旋的熔点下降，纤维变脆，结果就是坏血病 scurvy：牙龈出血、伤口不愈、血管脆弱。纤维的强度则来自另一条完全独立的交联通路，因为胶原蛋白几乎不含半胱氨酸、也没有二硫键：赖氨酰氧化酶 lysyl oxidase 这个铜酶把赖氨酸和羟赖氨酸侧链的氨基氧化成醛，醛再自发缩合成共价交联；交联随年龄累积、使组织变硬，而铜缺乏同样会导致结缔组织病变。

最后是一个流行的误解：胶原蛋白不是优质膳食蛋白。营养学上，完全蛋白 complete protein 指含有全部必需氨基酸 essential amino acids 且比例合适。胶原蛋白几乎完全不含色氨酸 tryptophan——这是它区别于几乎所有其他蛋白的特点，历史上就靠这一点鉴定——并且缺乏半胱氨酸、酪氨酸和蛋氨酸，因此属于不完全蛋白 incomplete protein。附带一条推论：口服的胶原蛋白与任何蛋白一样被消化成氨基酸和小肽，没有任何机制把它定向送到皮肤上。

heading_en: Supersecondary Structure, Domains, and How They Nest Inside Tertiary Structure
heading_zh: 超二级结构、结构域与三级结构的包含关系
en: A supersecondary structure is a regular combination formed by several elements of secondary structure interacting with one another. The decisive criterion, and the one to remember, is negative: it has not yet formed a defined functional domain, which is to say it has not reached the tertiary level. The familiar names, alpha-alpha, beta-alpha-beta, beta-beta, the Rossmann fold, the beta-meander and the Greek key, were coined by biochemists of the last century; such combinations are extremely common in nature even though the vocabulary is used less than it once was, and the combinations matter more than the names.

The Rossmann fold is worth knowing in detail. It is a beta-alpha-beta-alpha-beta unit in which six parallel strands form a sheet sandwiched between helices on both sides, and it exists to bind dinucleotide cofactors such as NAD+ and NADP+. At the first beta-alpha junction it carries a glycine-rich fingerprint, GxGxxG, which cradles the pyrophosphate group; spotting that motif in a sequence is almost enough to predict a dehydrogenase. The beta-meander, by comparison, is an antiparallel sheet built from consecutive strands joined end to end. The word motif itself carries two senses that must be separated: a structural motif is a spatial arrangement such as beta-alpha-beta or helix-turn-helix, that is, supersecondary structure, while a sequence motif is a conserved residue pattern such as GxGxxG or the C2H2 of a zinc finger. The two often correspond but are not equivalent, since the same structural motif can be realised by wholly unrelated sequences, which is the origin of the rule that structure is more conserved than sequence.

At the tertiary level there is a defined functional domain that can actually do something. A domain is a compact three-dimensional region assembled from several secondary and supersecondary elements, relatively independent of the rest of the chain and carrying out a specific function. Three operational tests make this concrete: it is typically 40 to 200 residues; it folds independently, so that expressing just that segment of the gene usually yields a protein folding to the same structure and keeping its activity, the experimental gold standard; and it is the unit of evolutionary recombination, recurring across unrelated proteins by domain shuffling, as with SH2, SH3 and the immunoglobulin fold. Domains are joined by loose, largely unstructured stretches of peptide, the standard illustration being DNA polymerase, whose fingers, thumb and palm are three separate domains on one chain.

The nesting relation is straightforward. Tertiary structure is the overall structure of a globular protein once the whole chain has assembled its secondary structures and domains, and domains sit inside it, one tertiary structure being able to contain several, three in the polymerase case. It is worth completing the hierarchy: primary structure is the amino-acid sequence, secondary the local regular conformation, tertiary the full three-dimensional structure of one polypeptide chain, quaternary the spatial arrangement of several separate chains, the subunits, as in the alpha2-beta2 of haemoglobin.
